description: Summarises automation test results in a date range: total tests, passed, failed, completed without a pass/fail mark, pass rate (over tests marked passed or failed), average duration and distinct builds, grouped by status, browser, os, build, device or day. Computed from test-level insights data (up to 2000 tests per call).

fromDate.description: Start date, YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to 30 days before toDate.

groupBy.description: Dimension to group by. Defaults to status.

toDate.description: End date, YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to today.
